title: Crunchyroll’s Solo Leveling Replacement Is Getting the Treatment One-Punch Man Deserved
content: Crunchyroll ‘s Solo Leveling replacement for Fall 2026 is emerging as one of the standout anime of the season, and it is also getting the treatment that fans hoped to see for One-Punch Man .
author: ComicBook

title: Magical Girl Raising Project F2P Manga Spinoff Ends in 5th Volume
content: The spinoff centers on Alma and Supinon, researchers in the land of magic, who head to "F City" to investigate reports of the existence of a magical girl with the power to "cancel death," and secure her if possible. But what they find in F City is beyond what they imagined.
author: ANN

title: 3 Shonen Jump Anime That Need Their Own Remake Like Dragon Ball Super
content: The Fall 2026 anime season is finally here with all the anticipated anime of the quarter, including the Dragon Ball Super: Beerus anime . While fans still have to wait for the main story’s continuation in the Galactic Patrol Saga, Toei Animation first released the remake TV series this month.

title: Bleach’s Final Episode Timeskip Officially Debuts Ichigo & Rukia’s Kids in the Anime
content: Bleach has now officially come to an end with the release of its final episode after 22 years of the anime, and with it has officially introduced Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki’s respective future children to the anime after a timeskip.
author: ComicBook

title: EAT-MAN The Over Order New Anime Gets Spinoff Manga Series
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account for EAT-MAN The Over Order , the new anime project for Akihito Yoshitomi 's Eat-Man manga, announced on Monday that Yoshitomi will launch a spinoff manga adaptation of the upcoming anime, titled Desert-Dessert From EAT-MAN The Over Order .
author: ANN

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Creator Is Returning With Exciting New Manga This Month
content: Ikuo Hachiya will be returning to Shonen Jump with a brand new manga after the cancellation of Ice-Head Gill . title: Manga Mavericks Books Licenses Gago Hunters Manga
content: Manga Mavericks Books , the publishing division of the Manga Mavericks website and podcast, announced on Monday during its online event that it has licensed Sho Yonoko's Gago Hunters: Greetings from Amatsumizu City's Gago Suppression Squad ( Amatsumizu-shi "Gago" Bokumetsu Dayori: Gagohan ) manga.
author: ANN

title: Dragon Ball Needs to Use Its Coolest Saiyan Form Much More Often
content: The most hyped transformation in Dragon Ball history is rarely used, so there should be a resurgence of Super Saiyan 3 in the future. Goku shattered everyone’s minds by taking more than five minutes of screen time to grow his hair longer, lose his eyebrows and make electricity surround him.
author: ComicBook

title: Marco Kohinata's Akari Manga Wins French Prix Ouest-France Award
content: French comic festival Quai des Bulles awarded the French-language version of Marco Kohinata 's Akari manga the Prix Ouest-France award as part of its event this year. The story also won the ABCD Asia Award 2026 in July.
author: ANN
